record.title: Zimbabwe renewed land-passenger COVID restriction January 2021
record.scope: Zimbabwe land ports; subsequent limited relaxation at Victoria Falls and Kazungula
record.direction: General travel in both directions restricted; stated exceptions qualify.
record.exceptions: Cargo, returning citizens and departing foreigners reported exempt; July relaxation for fully vaccinated travellers at two posts.
record.enforcement: National passenger restriction; category and port exceptions continued.
record.relationship: Distinct renewed phase after SC13; overlaps South African counterpart SC01 but is a separate imposing authority.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.context: Renewal after SC13 ended with December 2020 reopening.
record.uncertainty: January 2 announcement, January 3 reports and January 5 wider-lockdown dates cannot establish a single exact border-onset day. July endpoint is a tourism-sector reopening notice for two crossings, not observed all-border normalization; broader 2021–22 restrictions remain unresolved.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. No all-border duration; partial endpoint and imprecise start.
